capabilities: Automatically translate settings modal text about 2 seconds after opening
Translate into any chosen language with per-language caches
Persist translations in cache.json to reuse across sessions
Show session token usage and support debug diagnostics
Work in pop-out windows and on mobile
disambiguation: Not a note or document translator; it only translates text inside settings modals, never note contents, the main interface, or plugin source files.
extras: Pending review for the official Obsidian community directory; recommends installing via BRAT or manual file placement meanwhile. Includes a Chinese-language section mirroring the full documentation.
problem: Obsidian's settings UI is English-only, so non-English users must read plugin and core settings labels and descriptions in a language they may not know.

relations.evidence: Works with local servers (Ollama, LM Studio, etc.) and cloud services (DeepSeek, OpenAI, Kimi, Qwen, Zhipu GLM, etc.)
Any OpenAI-compatible API: Works with local servers (Ollama, LM Studio, etc.) and cloud services

requires.name: an OpenAI-compatible endpoint (local server such as Ollama or a cloud API)

summary: LLM-powered translator that rewrites text inside Obsidian settings modals into a chosen language using any OpenAI-compatible API, with persistent caching.
